bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears are gearing up for their 2026 season opener against the Carolina Panthers, with their first official injury report bringing good news on wide receiver Rome Odunze's health status, while the team also named five season-long captains including quarterback Caleb Williams, guard Joe Thuney, defensive tackle Grady Jarrett, linebacker T.J. Edwards, and kicker Cairo Santos.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Lions are gearing up for their Week 1 season opener against the New Orleans Saints, with edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson's impressive training camp seen as potentially setting him up for his best season yet , while the team also awaits the return of center Cade Mays, who is reportedly eyeing a mid-October return from his broken wrist . Meanwhile, Detroit's practice reports this week have focused on health and roster clarity, as the team debates splitting time between two players at left guard heading into the opener .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are finalizing preparations for their 2026 season opener against the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, with running back Josh Jacobs currently on the commissioner's exempt list and unable to practice or play. The Green Bay Packers are currently making their final preparations for the upcoming season, which is slated to get underway on Sunday, and running back Josh Jacobs is currently on the commissioner's exempt list, meaning he is unable to practice or play with the team.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings have re-signed veteran safety Harrison Smith to a one-year deal, and he's expected to pursue a Week 1 return against the Green Bay Packers, potentially with a limited workload.
